heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly to partly cloudy. Scattered showers or an evening storm north, widely scattered south. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Partly cloudy. Chance of showers or a thunderstorm, mainly north. Highs from the mid 70s to lower 80s. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Mostly to partly cloudy. Chance of showers near and north of Route 2, mainly early, and slight chance to the south; a thunderstorm possible early. Lows in the mid to upper 50s south and in the Champlain Valley, low to mid 50s elsewhere north. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph in the Champlain Valley.
